question: What is the standard duration of unprotected intercourse required to clinically define infertility in couples under 35 years?
explanation: Clinical guidelines establish twelve months of regular, unprotected intercourse as the threshold for investigating infertility in younger couples. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h1)

question: Why do doctors check for infertility sooner (after 6 months) in women who are 35 years or older?

options.A: Hormonal contraceptives remain active in older bodies longer
options.B: Uterine fibroids develop exclusively after the age of thirty-five
options.C: Egg quantity and quality drop faster as women get older
options.D: Menopause typically begins abruptly at this specific age

explanation: Egg quality and quantity decline progressively, necessitating earlier evaluation and intervention for older women. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h1)

question: A woman who has given birth before but cannot conceive again after trying for two years has what type of fertility issue?
explanation: Secondary infertility describes difficulty conceiving after a previous successful pregnancy of any outcome. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h2)

question: A patient had a baby three years ago, had two early miscarriages since then, and now cannot get pregnant for 14 months. What is this called?
explanation: Because a prior pregnancy was achieved, any current inability to conceive falls under secondary infertility. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h2)

question: What is the most common cause of blocked fallopian tubes leading to female infertility in areas with high infection rates?
explanation: Infections ascending from the lower reproductive tract cause scarring and occlusion of the fallopian tubes. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h3)

question: How does polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) mainly cause fertility problems in women?

options.A: By physically blocking the cervical os with thick mucus
options.B: By destroying the ciliated lining of the fallopian tubes
options.C: By accelerating the natural shedding of the uterine lining
options.D: By causing irregular periods and failure to release eggs

explanation: Hormonal imbalances in polycystic ovary syndrome prevent regular follicle maturation and the release of eggs. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h3)

question: How does a varicocele (swollen veins in the scrotum) lead to male infertility?

options.A: Increasing the temperature around the testes
options.D: Altering the pH of seminal fluid

explanation: Varicoceles pool warm blood around the testes, damaging the sensitive environment required for normal sperm production. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h4)

question: Which lifestyle or work habit is most directly linked to poor sperm production?

options.A: Consuming a diet high in plant proteins
options.C: Prolonged exposure to high heat around the scrotum

explanation: Sperm production is optimal at temperatures slightly below core body heat; prolonged heat exposure suppresses this process. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h4)

question: What is the main initial test used to check for male infertility?
explanation: Semen analysis provides immediate, non-invasive insight into sperm count, motility, and morphology. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h5)

question: What is the main reason a doctor orders a hysterosalpingography (HSG) during a fertility checkup for a woman?

options.A: To check the shape of the womb and see if the fallopian tubes are open
options.B: To stimulate the simultaneous release of multiple mature eggs
options.C: To measure circulating follicle-stimulating hormone levels directly
options.D: To identify active bacterial infections in the endocervical canal

explanation: Radiopaque dye is injected through the cervix to outline the uterine interior and confirm whether the fallopian tubes are open. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h5)

question: Which medication is commonly given to help women release eggs when they are not ovulating?
explanation: Clomiphene citrate stimulates the pituitary gland to release hormones that promote ovulation. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h6)

question: When is surgery (myomectomy) usually recommended to treat female infertility?

options.A: When small fibroids cause no symptoms whatsoever
options.B: When bilateral fallopian tubes are completely occluded by scar tissue
options.C: When large fibroids distort the shape of the womb
options.D: When male partners exhibit severe low sperm count and poor movement

explanation: Fibroids that interfere with implantation or distort the uterine architecture are surgically removed to improve pregnancy rates. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h6)

question: What procedure involves joining an egg and sperm in a lab dish and then placing the resulting embryo into the womb?
explanation: In vitro fertilization entails laboratory combination of gametes followed by uterine placement of the resulting embryo. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h7)

question: Which assisted reproduction technique is used for severe male infertility by injecting a single sperm directly into an egg?
explanation: Directly injecting a single healthy sperm into the oocyte bypasses barriers to natural fertilization in severe male factor cases. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h7)

question: How does infertility commonly affect a person's emotional health?

options.A: By completely taking away their ability to ever feel happy
options.B: By causing grief, worry, and social pressure
options.C: By causing temporary physical blindness during stress

explanation: The inability to conceive often leads to profound emotional distress and social pressure. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h8)

question: A patient undergoing failed IVF treatments feels worthless and avoids family gatherings. What is the best first action for the nurse?

options.A: Focus only on booking her next fertility treatment cycle
options.B: Tell her that most couples succeed eventually to cheer her up
options.C: Advise her to stop medical treatments immediately to save money
options.D: Acknowledge her emotional pain and provide a safe, listening ear

explanation: Active listening and emotional validation are foundational nursing interventions for patients experiencing psychosocial distress. [learn more](GNS312_U1_T19#GNS312_U1_T19_h8)
